# api-dead-ends

> Local CLI (never changes code) + MCP server + Claude Code plugin. Compares an OpenAPI spec (or a framework route list) with real API traffic aggregated from logs/APM/metrics, and lists: endpoints with server errors (5xx share), client errors (4xx), undocumented (shadow) endpoints, endpoints not called in the window (with confidence), deprecated endpoints still called. Numbers are computed by code, not by an LLM. "Not called" is a hint, never proof that an endpoint is dead.

## Install
- CLI: `npx api-dead-ends init` (Node.js >= 20, 22+ recommended, zero dependencies)
- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add talikbaku/api-dead-ends` then `/plugin install api-dead-ends@api-dead-ends-marketplace`
- MCP client: `{"mcpServers":{"ade":{"command":"npx","args":["-y","api-dead-ends@0.3.0","mcp"]}}}`
- UTCP client: manual from `npx -y api-dead-ends@0.3.0 utcp` (cli call template)

## Main commands
- `init` — scan repo, ask questions, write `.api-dead-ends/NEXT-STEPS.md` (`--yes`, `--json`, `--dry-run`, `--source`, `--service`, `--spec`, `--routes`, `--logs`, `--days`)
- `query <source>` — print the query for elasticsearch, datadog, datadog-apm, prometheus (--preset), loki, victorialogs, appinsights, cloudwatch, athena, bigquery, newrelic, dynatrace, splunk
- `convert <source> <file>` — saved response → usage table (method,path,calls,first_seen,last_seen,status)
- `spec from-routes <routes.txt|json>` — OpenAPI from rails/flask/django/spring/gin/echo/laravel/express route lists
- `report --usage usage.csv --spec openapi.json --days N --out dir/` (`--spec` accepts OpenAPI JSON or YAML) — report.md + report.json; `--json` prints JSON; `--baseline` + `--fail-on new-shadow,deprecated-growth` for CI
- `report` also writes report.html; with `convert --daily` it shows 30/7/3/1-day windows and recent 5xx spikes
- `fetch kibana --url <Discover URL> --service S` / `fetch victorialogs --url http://host:9428 [--service S]` — export straight from the source (browser login / read-only LogsQL); `--hourly`, `--errors errors.json` (error texts from the same traces)
- incident: `report --include-today --errors errors.json --tz Zone` on an hourly table → `changes` in report.json: 5xx up today with the first hour, totals and peak req/s vs the same hours before, calls and 5xx up together, appeared/vanished endpoints
- `probe <url> [--spec F]` — browser visit (Playwright): duplicate/broken/slow API calls per page; human-run only
- `convert accesslog … --duplicates dup.json` — repeated POST/PATCH from one client; `report --duplicates dup.json`
- `coverage --usage app.csv --reference ingress.csv` — endpoints not logged by the app; `logging-check` — "do not log" settings in code
- `logging-probe send --url <STAGING> --spec F -o run.json` / `logging-probe verify --run run.json --logs F` — active logging check: marked requests to staging, then finds the markers in your log export; staging only, CLI only (not an MCP tool)
- `spec from-next <dir>` — Next.js routes
- `mcp` — stdio MCP server; read tools: detect_project, setup_plan, build_query, spec_from_routes, analyze_usage; write tools: init, write_report (only config + .api-dead-ends/)
- `utcp` — prints a UTCP manual with the read tools

## Rules for agents
- Never treat "not called" as dead; state window and confidence; recommend, don't delete.
- Never paste raw logs, bodies, tokens or customer data; work from usage tables and report.json.
- Humans run queries against production; never send non-GET requests to production.
